summary: Learn advanced RCA tools, CAPA design, and verification methods. Reduce repeat problems and improve reporting with TrainingCred.
lede: Root cause analysis training helps quality, operations, safety, maintenance, and service professionals investigate recurring failures. It guides teams from problem definition and evidence review to causal mapping with tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone and Pareto, then toward corrective actions and checks that confirm whether fixes worked.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who investigate recurring failures, lead corrective action, or own process performance in quality, operations, safety, maintenance, service, or compliance environments.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of operational problems, incidents, or quality issues in your function; familiarity with basic process documents, nonconformance records, incident reports, or corrective action logs; no coding required. The course assumes you can read simple charts and tables and are ready to work on real workplace cases. Advanced concepts are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level, so you can apply tools confidently without needing statistical software expertise.
